summary: Acorn Energy's OmniMetrix subsidiary entered an Asset Purchase Agreement dated September 9, 2026 to buy all assets of Generator Solutions, Inc.'s Gen-Tracker standby generator monitoring business, closing immediately the same day. Total consideration is $3,500,000: $1,000,000 paid at closing, $450,000 payable on each of the first four anniversaries, and $700,000 on the fifth anniversary, effectively seller-financed deferred consideration. Acquired items include customer accounts, dealer relationships, trade names, trademarks, technology, receivables and hardware inventory. OmniMetrix also signed a one-year lease with a Seller affiliate in Oakdale, Minnesota at $108,000 annually. No board recommendation or advisor disclosed.
